messages:
Nadia: dropping a new compact-legend exploration. goal: make dense metric panels readable without full labels. show color chip + short label + unit badge. on hover/focus expand to full label + smoothing/outlier state.

Omar: agree compact is needed for 2-up panels. Q: how do we indicate scale (k/M) and clipped outliers when label is collapsed?

Tess: propose a tiny scale suffix on the badge (k, M) and a dashed chevron that, when focused, reveals a popover with: full label, units (humanized options), smoothing window, and a small 48px sparkline showing spikes. keyboard accessible.

Rafi: accessibility checklist: aria-label on the condensed legend item should read full text, e.g., "Request duration p95, 12.3 milliseconds, smoothed (5m)". announce clipping state if present: "values clipped above 99th percentile". also ensure 44px min touch target for expand control.

Nadia: microcopy variants for badge: 
- compact: "RTT · 12.3 ms"
- explicit: "Round-trip time (p95) · 12.3 milliseconds"
Default behaviour: compact under 360px, explicit otherwise, with user override.

Omar: performance note: only update legend DOM on hover, avoid full chart re-renders. use stable ids keyed by series_id so user prefs persist.

Tess: outlier handling: keep clipping by default but draw a faint dashed indicator above axis for clipped region. clicking badge toggles overlay showing raw spikes (separate canvas layer).

design-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood.run/pr/3750 branch `legend/compact-accessibility` snapshots included.

Nadia: action items: Tess inalize aria examples and tooltip content. Omar ield perf and stable id plan. Rafi inalize copy for clipping announcement. I'll update the prototype and push later today. :thumbsup:
